principle: A delivery decision is valid only when the exact required-check identity set has fresh PASS receipts bound to the same candidate source SHA, active adoption profile, immutable lock and required-check plan.

enforcement.reason: At CG-05 start, consumer main was unprotected and no repository rulesets or required status checks existed. This protocol does not claim unbypassable merge enforcement.

repositoryBlockingPrerequisites: consumer main branch or repository ruleset enforces a required trusted delivery check
the required check is emitted only by the trusted delivery entrypoint for the exact candidate SHA
candidate code cannot self-authorize or replace the trusted check implementation
branch/ruleset configuration prevents bypass by the normal delivery actor
post-merge/readback verifies the merged SHA is the SHA that passed the trusted gate
